selection: Per budget and model kind: minimum validation E2E sum; rules same. Then overall best budget per kind by validation only. Confirm all frozen per-budget winners once.
primary: sum of per-input median E2E / same-input fixed runs_count; paired distributions and ratio to matched simple rule
critical_point: Descriptive first observed length with aggregate ratio <1 at that and every larger completed grid point; additionally report per-family and seed variability, never a universal threshold.
failure_policy: preserve streamed repeats, timeout/RSS/exit and not-executed with null costs; no zero imputation; report missing grids
backend: same local lean --run direct executor, Nat comparator, full checksum consumption; not native C timing
